seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Two-axis mirror game on 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: model {H row, V col, pieces, targets, selection}.
ACTION5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H; A1/A2 move H axis or piece by rows, A3/A4 move V axis or piece by cols.
Reflections: the one across V is visible gray; the ones across H and across both axes are invisible occluders. Layers piece>refl>target>wall, then re-extract and re-rank names.
Hidden state only caches the model, gated on continuity. It also passes 44/44 with hidden state off, so no hidden counter was needed.
Not confirmed: blocking between pieces and axes, piece cycle order after pieces move past each other, ACTION6/7 (treated as no-ops).
